amendments.sig-shakahola: A wound carried by the whole county — recorded here so the recovery context is never invisible.

sips.title: The commitment pool
sips.what_changes: The ROLA pool already moves 1,640 swaps of labour and goods. If planting days join it, the pool becomes the staffing layer the schemes lack.

sips.title: What twelve people do in a day
sips.what_changes: 480 seedlings in one day by twelve people. Two more crews at that rate close the propagule gap inside one season.

sips.title: The planting window
sips.what_changes: Planting windows are tidal and seasonal. Missing the window costs a year of establishment.
